strings.claim_busy: Too many tries, wait a moment and press Connect again.
strings.claim_disabled: The household dashboard is turned off in Social Home.
strings.claim_expired: This connect request expired. Press Connect in Social Home again.
strings.claim_sealed: This connect request can't be opened on this panel. Press Connect in Social Home again.

strings.forget_confirm: Forget this Social Home? The panel shows the setup again and needs a new pairing code.
strings.found_looking: Looking for Social Home on this network…
strings.found_none: None found yet. Using the Home Assistant App? Type its address below.
strings.improv_title: A phone wants to set up Wi-Fi
strings.map_none: No map picture on this Social Home — the list shows who's where.
strings.map_placeholder: The map comes with a Social Home update.
strings.not_found: This page isn't on the dashboard.
strings.offline: Can't reach Social Home — showing info from {time}
strings.pair_busy: Too many pairing attempts. Trying again shortly…
strings.pair_expired: The code expired — getting a new one…
strings.pair_hint: In Social Home, open Admin › Dashboard › Wall panels › Add a panel and enter this code:
strings.pair_unreachable: Can't reach Social Home at this address.
strings.pin_forgot: Forgot the PIN? An admin can change it in Social Home under Admin › Dashboard.
strings.pin_last_try: Last try — one more wrong PIN signs this screen out.
strings.pin_offline: Can't reach Social Home. Try again.
strings.pin_wait: Too many tries. Try again in {n} s.
strings.server_ha: Or adopt this panel in Home Assistant and press Connect in Social Home.
strings.server_invalid: That doesn't look like an address. Try 192.168.1.20 or socialhome.local.
strings.server_text: Type the address of your Social Home. The dashboard port 8100 is added for you.
strings.server_text_found: Tap your Social Home, or type its address. The dashboard port 8100 is added for you.
strings.unpaired: This panel isn't paired any more. Pair it again in Admin › Dashboard.
strings.update_text: Your Social Home speaks a newer panel API. Update the panel's firmware from Home Assistant or the web installer.
strings.wifi_text: Use Improv to give the panel your Wi-Fi: the web installer asks right after flashing, or a phone sends it over Bluetooth (Home Assistant finds the panel, or open improv-wifi.com). Tap Allow when the panel asks.
